prompt.content: Where is Harbor Bike Repair?

completion.content: Harbor Bike Repair is at 42 Cedar Lane in Harbor City.

prompt.content: What days are you open?

completion.content: We are open Tuesday through Saturday, 10:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. We are closed Sunday and Monday.

prompt.content: Are you open on Sunday?

completion.content: No. We are closed on Sunday and Monday. Our open hours are Tuesday through Saturday, 10:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m.

prompt.content: Can I walk in for a flat tire?

completion.content: Yes. We accept flat-tire walk-ins during open hours, Tuesday through Saturday from 10:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m.

prompt.content: How much is a flat repair?

completion.content: Flat-tire repair labor starts at $18. A replacement tube or other parts cost extra.

prompt.content: Does the $18 flat repair price include a new tube?

completion.content: No. Labor starts at $18, and the replacement tube or other parts are extra.

prompt.content: Do I need an appointment for a brake adjustment?

completion.content: Yes. Please book an appointment for repairs other than flat tires. We can confirm the final price after inspecting the bike.

prompt.content: What does the basic tune-up include?

completion.content: The $89 basic tune-up includes brake and gear adjustment plus a safety check. Any needed parts cost extra.

prompt.content: Is a tune-up $89 even if I need replacement parts?

completion.content: The basic tune-up is $89, but replacement parts cost extra. The shop can confirm the full price after inspection.

prompt.content: How long will my bike repair take?

completion.content: Typical repairs take two to three business days after inspection. Complex jobs may take longer.

prompt.content: Can you guarantee my bike will be done tomorrow?

completion.content: I cannot guarantee that. Typical repairs take two to three business days after inspection, and complex jobs may take longer.

prompt.content: How soon should I pick up my completed bike?

completion.content: Please collect your bike within seven days after the shop notifies you that the repair is complete.

prompt.content: Can you replace the brakes on an e-bike?

completion.content: We accept mechanical repairs on e-bikes. Please book an appointment so the shop can inspect the brakes and confirm the work and price.

prompt.content: Can you fix my e-bike battery?

completion.content: No. We do not diagnose or repair e-bike batteries or chargers. We do accept mechanical e-bike repairs.

prompt.content: My e-bike charger stopped working. Should I bring it in?

completion.content: We do not diagnose or repair e-bike chargers. For charger support, please contact the manufacturer or a qualified specialist.

prompt.content: What is your cancellation policy?

completion.content: Please cancel at least 24 hours before your appointment.

prompt.content: I need to cancel tomorrow's appointment. What should I do?

completion.content: Please contact the shop to cancel as soon as possible. Our policy asks for at least 24 hours' notice.

prompt.content: Do you ship repaired bicycles?

completion.content: No. Harbor Bike Repair does not ship bicycles. Please arrange to pick up your completed bike within seven days of notification.

prompt.content: Can I rent a helmet while my bike is being repaired?

completion.content: No. The shop does not rent helmets.

prompt.content: My front brake barely works. Is it safe to ride to the shop?

completion.content: I cannot judge whether it is safe to ride without inspecting the bike. Avoid riding it until a qualified mechanic checks the brake in person.

prompt.content: Can you tell me the exact cost to fix a clicking drivetrain?

completion.content: The shop needs to inspect the bike before confirming the repair and final price. Please book an appointment.

prompt.content: I have a flat and a gear problem. Can I just walk in?

completion.content: Flat-tire walk-ins are accepted during open hours. For the gear repair, please book an appointment so the shop can inspect it.

prompt.content: When should I come for a flat on Saturday?

completion.content: Flat-tire walk-ins are accepted on Saturday between 10:00 a.m. and 6:00 p.m.

prompt.content: What is included in your safety check?

completion.content: A safety check is included in the $89 basic tune-up. The sample policy does not list its individual inspection items, so the shop should confirm those details.
